shortDescription: Query information on one or more storage boxes

options.name: full_info
options.description: Whether to provide full information for every storage box. Setting this to V(true) requires one REST call per storage box, which is slow and reduces your rate limit. Use with care. When O(storagebox_id) is specified, this option is always treated as having value V(true). B(Note) that this option has no effect if O(hetzner_token) is specified.

options.name: hetzner_password
options.description: The password for the Robot web-service user. If O(hetzner_password) is specified, O(hetzner_user) must also be specified, and O(hetzner_token) must not be specified. This option is deprecated for this module, and support will be removed in community.hrobot 3.0.0.

options.name: hetzner_token
options.description: The API token for the Robot web-service user. One of O(hetzner_token) and O(hetzner_user) must be specified. This option will be required from community.hrobot 3.0.0 on.

options.name: hetzner_user
options.description: The username for the Robot web-service user. One of O(hetzner_token) and O(hetzner_user) must be specified. If O(hetzner_user) is specified, O(hetzner_password) must also be specified, and O(hetzner_token) must not be specified. This option is deprecated for this module, and support will be removed in community.hrobot 3.0.0.

options.name: linked_server_number
options.description: Limit result list to storage boxes linked to the server with this number. Ignored when O(storagebox_id) has been specified, or when O(hetzner_token) has been specified.

options.name: rate_limit_retry_timeout
options.description: Timeout (in seconds) for waiting when rate limit exceeded errors are returned. Set to V(0) to not retry. Set to a negative value like V(-1) to retry forever.

options.name: storagebox_id
options.description: Limit result list to storage boxes with this ID.
